PluginData.Author: lolifamily
PluginData.Tooltip: Full HDR pipeline: fp16 scRGB swapchain, BT.2390 tonemapping, R16 lighting buffer, separate UI brightness, emissive boost
PluginData.Description: Replaces SE's SDR tonemapping pipeline with a true HDR path. Swapchain is upgraded to flip model R16G16B16A16_Float with scRGB color space. Lighting, bloom and post-process buffers are upgraded to R16G16B16A16 for full-precision HDR. BT.2390 tonemapping keeps the original shadows and midtones at a configurable paper white and extends highlights up to the display peak. Emissive billboards and GPU particles (flames, muzzle flashes, exhaust) can be boosted; diffuse content is untouched. UI and in-world overlays (block highlight, gizmos, crosshair) have their own brightness setting. Screenshots are captured as OpenEXR (HDR) and tonemapped PNG (SDR) in parallel. Optional G-Sync/FreeSync tearing support and low-latency mode (1-frame GPU queue). Auto-disables itself if it crashes during init, with a flag in the config to re-enable. Requires Windows HDR enabled and a supported display; can be force-enabled on SDR displays.
